verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo at top and has no collisions, but the cream jar is reduced to an unreadable speck stranded below the CTA, the bottle sits off-centre against a right-shifted circle, $48 is shrunk so it no longer dominates, the 'THE NIGHT SET' eyebrow has moved below its own copy, and there is a large dead gap above the button. B keeps a big $48, but the price and copy run across the circle's edge, the bottle overlaps the circle edge awkwardly, the logo is demoted to the bottom next to a tiny jar with an illegible label, and the eyebrow is again misordered below the body copy. Both are broken; A is slightly cleaner and keeps the brand in its original place.
